set(_target "erhe_version")

# The one translation unit carries the project version and the source
# tree's `git describe`. It is regenerated by erhe_version_stamp at every
# build (and here at configure time so the first generation has it);
# generate_version.cmake rewrites it only when the content changed, so a
# build at an unchanged commit recompiles nothing.
set(ERHE_VERSION_CPP "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/version.cpp")
set(ERHE_VERSION_OUTPUT      "${ERHE_VERSION_CPP}")
set(ERHE_PROJECT_VERSION     "${PROJECT_VERSION}")
set(ERHE_SOURCE_DIR          "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}")
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generate_version.cmake")

add_custom_target(
    erhe_version_stamp
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
        "-DERHE_VERSION_OUTPUT=${ERHE_VERSION_CPP}"
        "-DERHE_PROJECT_VERSION=${PROJECT_VERSION}"
        "-DERHE_SOURCE_DIR=${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}"
        -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generate_version.cmake"
    BYPRODUCTS "${ERHE_VERSION_CPP}"
    COMMENT "Stamping erhe version (git describe)"
    VERBATIM
)
set_property(TARGET erhe_version_stamp PROPERTY FOLDER "erhe")

add_library(${_target} "${ERHE_VERSION_CPP}")
add_library(erhe::version ALIAS ${_target})
erhe_target_sources_grouped(
    ${_target} TREE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" FILES
    erhe_version/version.hpp
    generate_version.cmake
)
add_dependencies(${_target} erhe_version_stamp)

target_include_directories(${_target} PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

erhe_target_settings(${_target} "erhe")
